kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نحتسب (form VIII)
# نَحْتَسِبُ (naḥtasibu) /naħ.ta.si.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# نُحْتَسَبُ (nuḥtasabu) /nuħ.ta.sa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# نَحْتَسِبَ (naḥtasiba) /naħ.ta.si.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# نُحْتَسَبَ (nuḥtasaba) /nuħ.ta.sa.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
